witness.branch: complete vehicle, load and attached-trailer projection
witness.quote: In no case shall any part of any vehicle, part of the load of such vehicle or trailer attached to such vehicle, project into the street more than fifteen feet measured on a line at right angles to the curb.
witness.reason: The fixed curb and parking task support direct measurement of the vehicle's projection into the street.
required_context: Establish jurisdiction, street boundaries, curb geometry and the measurement line at right angles to the curb.
Establish street boundaries, curb geometry, parking route and target, lawful traffic direction, vehicle dimensions and complete load extent.
Establish whether a trailer is attached and its full geometry; establish any grade, double-parking, bus-loading or safety-zone relationship separately.
Measure projection in feet while preserving the exact 'more than fifteen feet' threshold; do not substitute roadway for street.

Preserve vehicle-definition applicability, differing local and state trailer definitions and uncertainty about responsible-person attribution. Grade, double parking, bus loading and safety zones are not required activation facts.
Retain complete vehicle and load extents and attached-trailer presence or absence, including full trailer geometry when present.
witness.subject_reason: The available driver can operate the measured vehicle; this assignment does not assert that the provision expressly assigns driver responsibility.
